run_zmq_publisher: run the zmq PUB socket that streams random numpy arrays to tcp://*:5555 on topic randomstream
run_stream_samples: run the stream_samples function to continuously publish random feature vectors at 10 Hz via zmq
create_zmq_pub_socket: create a zmq PUB socket bound to tcp://*:5555 for publishing random data streams
refactor_stream_samples: refactor stream_samples to support configurable sample rate, feature count, endpoint, and topic
review_zmq_source: review the zmq_source module and its stream_samples function for zmq PUB socket usage patterns
